#!/usr/bin/env bash
# frames/*.png -> renders/robot_arm_pov_15s.mp4  (1920x1080, 30 fps, 15 s)
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
mkdir -p renders
ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel warning \
